description: This source file defines the configuration structures, loading logic, and environment variable overrides for the AgentField server. It includes data types for various configuration sections such as UI, API, storage, and feature toggles, along with a function to load and parse the configuration file.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Holds the entire configuration for the AgentField server.

classes.name: UIConfig
classes.description: Configuration for the web UI, including its enabled state, mode, source and distribution paths, and development port.

classes.name: AgentFieldConfig
classes.description: Core configuration for the AgentField server, including port and cleanup/queue settings.

classes.name: ExecutionCleanupConfig
classes.description: Settings for execution cleanup and garbage collection, such as retention period and cleanup interval.

classes.name: ExecutionQueueConfig
classes.description: Configuration for execution and webhook timeouts, retries, and related parameters.

classes.name: FeatureConfig
classes.description: Feature toggles for enabling/disabling specific system features like DID.

classes.name: DIDConfig
classes.description: Configuration related to the DID identity system, including method, key algorithm, rotation, and VC requirements.

classes.name: VCRequirements
classes.description: Specifications for verifiable credential requirements in different contexts.

classes.name: KeystoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration for the keystore, including type, path, encryption method, and backup schedule.

classes.name: APIConfig
classes.description: Configuration for API settings, including CORS and authentication.

classes.name: AuthConfig
classes.description: API authentication configuration, including API key and paths that bypass authentication.

classes.name: StorageConfig
classes.description: Alias of the storage layer config imported from internal storage package.

methods.name: LoadConfig
methods.description: Reads configuration from a specified path or default locations, parses it, and applies environment variable overrides.

methods.name: applyEnvOverrides
methods.description: Overrides certain config fields with environment variables if they are set.
